chapter.heading: Psalm 61Confidence in God’s Protection.To the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments. A Psalm of David.
chapter.v:
Hear my
cry, O God;Listen to my prayer.

From the
end of the earth I call to You, when my heart is overwhelmed and weak;Lead me to the rock that is higher than I [a rock that is too high to reach without Your help].

For You
have been a shelter and a refuge for me,A strong tower against the enemy.

Let me
dwell in Your tent forever;Let me take refuge in the shelter of Your wings. Selah.

¶For You
have heard my vows, O God;You have given me the inheritance of those who fear Your name [with reverence].

You will
prolong the king’s life [adding days upon days];His years will be like many generations.

He will
sit enthroned forever before [the face of] God;Appoint lovingkindness and truth to watch over and preserve him.

So I
will sing praise to Your name forever,Paying my vows day by day.
